Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.teavm

Class Trace

java.lang.Object
net.sourceforge.plantuml.teavm.Trace
public final class Trace extends Object
TEMPORARY, to be removed: traces to find why the C executable fails in the job "Build linux-x64" of the CI (NullPointerException in the CRC32 of the PNG chunks with a heap of 64 MB, segmentation fault with 128 MB).

The traces go to the standard error and only exist in the C build, where Run installs the stream with install(PrintStream). Elsewhere (JVM, tests, JavaScript) nothing is written.
